Definition: a net-work, i.e. (in hunting) a snare, (in architecture) a ballustrade; also a reticulated ornament to a pillar
BiblicalUsage: A sebakah is network, checker work, and it dressed the temple: nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the chapiters upon the pillars, seven for the one chapiter and seven for the other, with two rows round about upon the one network to cover the chapiters with pomegranates.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the lattice on a pillar was ordered by God — the house He dwells in is finished down to the checker work.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
